snippet.title: The People of Sea, Sun & Salt – OUT NOW | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The People of Sea, Sun & Salt is OUT NOW on Steam 🌊🏝️

Build your island city, shape your people and watch your civilization evolve over time in a relaxing, atmospheric world.

👉 Buy now (-10% launch discount):
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4005760/The_people_of_Sea_Sun__Salt/

Create your own island settlement
Grow and guide your population
Watch your civilization develop organically
Relax in a warm, coastal setting

Limited-time launch discount available now.
